partnershipPlan: Two link workers and two people who have used social prescribing review the outcome list and the plain-language summary; the voluntary sector forum comments on community capacity.
socialListening: No social media listening; comments from the network's patient participation groups on link workers are summarised without identifiers.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: It was the first time in years someone had time to sit down and sort out the letters with me.
items.implication: Report wellbeing and engagement outcomes separately from service use.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: They found me a walking group, but it was two buses away and I stopped after a week.
items.implication: Extract what reviews say about availability of activities.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: The people who need us most take ten appointments, not three; the targets do not fit them.
items.implication: Report findings for people with complex needs separately.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Every referral lands on a volunteer group that has lost its funding twice this year.
items.implication: Note whether reviews counted voluntary sector costs.

summary: Four composite voices on time, access, complex needs and community capacity.
